thesis: Morgan Housel explains that his career shift from writing about public markets at the Motley Fool to venture capital at the Collaborative Fund was driven by a desire to try something new within his field of finance rather than changing professions entirely. He contrasts the analytical, spreadsheet-based due diligence of public markets with the qualitative, belief-based approach of venture capital, noting that while many theories on risk and psychology carry over, the methods for evaluating opportunity differ significantly.
